comparison.durability_level: Local majority persist (2 of 3) before producer ACK; async durable WAN replication

kamish.wan_replication: Offset-preserving, single-record outbox with crash-safe atomic reservation
kamish.residency_enforcement: Cryptographic signed policy at ingress, egress, and relay
kamish.storage: Segmented crash-durable CRC32-checksummed append log with sparse index

kafka_mirrormaker2.residency_enforcement: Manual topic partitioning and routing (no cryptographic boundary)
kafka_mirrormaker2.storage: Log segment files with time/size rolling and .index/.timeindex

apache_pulsar.wan_replication: Built-in full-duplex cross-cluster geo-replication on namespace
apache_pulsar.residency_enforcement: Cluster whitelist on tenant/namespace (no cryptographically signed envelope)
apache_pulsar.storage: BookKeeper ledgers with journal and entry loggers
